name: Les Rallizes Dénudés
summary: Les Rallizes Dénudés  were a Japanese psychedelic noise rock band formed in 1967 in Kyoto, Japan. They gained a reputation many years after their breakup as one of Japan's most legendary experimental bands, and were a forcible influence on the noise rock scene within Japan and abroad. Much of their popularity comes from their enigmatic, mysterious presence on and off stage, a scarcity of official releases and information on the band, an abnormally high number of live bootlegs from throughout their career, and a strong cult following.
